$comment: A person, or the sweep with `by` null, asks for something. A `go` names the plan the person approves by it, `plan.text.ref` in the state, or null when the item has no plan; a go for another plan changes nothing. Other requests send null. A `fix` with `by` null and `automatic` true is the host's own automatic fix round, which the engine counts and marks as it does its own due round.

title.$comment: The work item's title as it is now, when the host gives it again, such as on a request that starts a plan.

automatic.$comment: Only on a `fix`, sent with `by` null: the host's own automatic fix round, which the engine counts toward `fixRounds` and marks automatic as it does its own due round. Absent or false: a person's request.

depth.$comment: How many levels of parts the item is below the item first split, when the host gives it again.
